<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-05-0402-41-22" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Body of the text (1b4-)"/>
         || de la spyir lus can rnams kyi bde' sdug ni shes bya'i de kho na nyid rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa las byung zhing rtogs par byed pa'i thabs kyang rigs pa dang lung dang man ngag gsum yin pa las | rigs pas rtogs pa ni myong pa'i mi 'khrul ba'i rtags la brten pa'i phyir brtag pa gsum gyis dag pa'i gser bzang po ltar ches brling pa yin_no || <lb n="1b5"/> rigs pa'i tshul de yang thog mar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3771">slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po</rs>s <rs type="deity">bde' bar gshegs pa</rs>'i gsung gi cha nyid las rnyed de bdag dang gzhan gyi rtog ge yang dag pa dang ltar snang pa'i rnam gzhag mdo' tsam du ston pa <rs type="work">tshad ma kun las btus pa</rs> mdzad la | de'i tshig shin tu brling pa 'jig rten rmongs pa dag gis ma shes nas chos dang gang zag gnyi' ga kun gyis smad par gyur pa na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773">dpal chos kyi grags pa</rs> 'jig rten du byon te gzhung de rtog ge'i tshul phyin ci ma log pa'i don can du dgongs <lb n="1b6"/>zhing | chos dang gang zag khyad par can la mi bden pas smod pa bzlog pa'i phyir de'i lugs kyi rigs pa'i tshul gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos <rs type="work">sde bdun</rs> mdzad de | gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos rgyas 'bring bsdus pa <rs type="work">rnam 'grel</rs> ¦ <rs type="work">rnam nges</rs> ¦ <rs type="work">rigs pa'i thigs pa</rs> gsuM dang | lus kyi cha shas la 'khrul pa spong pa yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi ste || 
         de yang mngon suM ni log par rtogs pa'i gnas nyung pas de las 'phros pa'i bstan bcos med la | <lb n="1b7"/> rjes dpag gi rgyu rtags gyi mtshan nyid dang 'brel pa la 'khrul pa spong pa <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5831">gtan tshigs thigs pa</rs> dang <rs type="work">'brel pa brtag pa</rs> gnyis dang | gzhan don rjes dpag dgod pa'i yul phyir rgol la blo yod par bsgrub pa dang rgol phyir rgol gyi ngag [b]rtag pa <rs type="work">rgyud gzhan grub pa</rs> dang <rs type="work">rtsod pa'i rigs pa</rs> gnyis te bzhi'o || 
         de ltar <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3771"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3770">mdo'</rs> mdzad pa</rs>'i gzhung <rs type="work">rnam 'grel mdzad pa</rs>s gsal bar phye la || <rs type="work">rnam 'grel mdzad pa</rs>'i gzhung de dag kyang dpag par dka' ba'i <lb n="1b8"/> blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis lan mang du rnam par phye mod kyi 'on kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">de dag</rs> gi gzhung la 'jug par mi nus pa'i skye bo blo dang brtson pa chung pa dag gis <rs type="work">rnam 'grel mdzad pa</rs>'i rigs pa'i lam bde blag du shes par bya ba'i phyir 'dir tshig nyung pas don gsal bar bstan par bya'o ||</seg></TEI>
